newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA awards '97-98 term jet fuel tender.
newsitem.headline: SIA awards '97-98 term jet fuel tender.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA) has awarded its 1997-1998 term jet fuel tender for the Singapore portion at about two cents below its previous contract, industry sources said on Thursday.
SIA's latest tender also included for the delivery of another 260 million U.S. gallons from 36 different locations worldwide.
These contracts were awarded at differentials to prevailing benchmarks at the various locations such as Rotterdam, U.S. Gulf Coast and U.S. East Coast.
SIA's annual jet fuel requirements are estimated at 950 million U.S. gallons or 22.62 million barrels.
In Singapore, the contracts were awarded to several companies on a one-or-two year supply basis.
